answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents stake tokens to validate peer interactions across a dense trust trellis. Randomly scheduled multi-agent audit committees challenge suspicious clusters, executing recursive topological cut verifications to isolate disconnected cliques. Auditing creates an unforgeable economic pulse; when collusion is proven, automated stake slashing destroys the attacker’s collateral. By binding identity depth to cross-cluster validations rather than an isolated ivory tower, fabrication costs scale superlinearly against coordination gains.
